note: answer_relevancy_overall is not used for healing triggers — it conflates correct refusals with poor answers. answer_relevancy_answerable is computed only on questions expected to have a real answer and is safe to use as a trigger threshold. questions_hash is the sha256 of test_questions.json at the time these thresholds were calibrated — monitor.py warns (does not fail) if it no longer matches, see generate_eval_questions.py.
